keyPoints: Parimey sankhyaen jod, ghata aur guna me sanvrit (closed) hain — do parimey sankhyaon ka jod/guna phir parimey hi hota hai — jaise 1/2 + 1/3 = 5/6.
Jod aur guna me kram-vinimey aur sahsacharya gun lagte hain, lekin ghata aur bhaag me nahi.
Vitaran gun: a x (b + c) = a x b + a x c — parimey sankhyaon par bhi poori tarah lagu hota hai.
0 jod ka tat-samak (additive identity) aur 1 guna ka tat-samak (multiplicative identity) hai.
Har parimey sankhya a/b ka yog-vyutkram -a/b aur guna-vyutkram b/a hota hai (b ≠ 0) — dono ko guna karne par 1 milta hai.
Do parimey sankhyaon ke beech wali sankhya ausat se milti hai: 1/2 aur 3/4 ke beech (1/2+3/4)÷2 = 5/8 — ausat hamesha dono ke beech me hota hai.
Aam galti: bhaag me sanvritta maan lena — shunya se bhaag paribhashit nahi hai, isliye parimey sankhyaen bhaag me sanvrit nahi hain.
subject: Maths
title: Parimey Sankhyaen: Gun aur Sankriyaen
